format: Edited narrated walkthrough of actual app captures; not a continuous screen recording.

editing.transitions: Straight cuts between real captured states; no simulated pointer actions or generated app screens.
editing.sizing: Explicit source-pixel crops or uniform contain; original aspect ratios preserved.
editing.on_screen_disclosure: Edited walkthrough · actual app captures · synthetic data
editing.separate_inspector_check: 49.798–54.364 seconds uses a separately labeled saved-revision-11 QA capture, then returns explicitly to the main revision-5 walkthrough.
editing.third_request_rule: A pair-specific rule verified by application tests; the displayed capture shows the actual two-request duplicate review state. No third-request screen or action was invented.

narration.timing_basis: Original word and character timestamps; not evenly distributed timing.

renderer.dependencies: Python 3.10+, Pillow, FFmpeg with libx264/drawtext, and ffprobe
renderer.media_paths: Relative to this evidence folder when the original media bundle is restored.
